purpose: Social proof via recognizable customer/partner logos immediately after the hero.

desktop.layout: featured repeat(4,1fr) gap 24; grid repeat(5,1fr) gap 12/20

tablet.layout: 3 groups flex row, each repeat(2,1fr); grid repeat(4,1fr)

phone.layout: 3 groups stacked, each 2 columns; featured/grid repeat(2,1fr)

motion.reducedMotionFallback: dot renders static at full opacity, no blink loop

customer-logo.guidance: COMPLIANCE: these are REAL third-party company trademarks (e.g. Gallea AI, Smallest.ai, Klaar, competitor wordmarks like HeyReach/Expandi/Lemlist). Never AI-generate, redraw, or alter a real company's logo. Use only the licensed/sourced exact asset, or omit the logo entirely for a fictional/example company.
